title: Pure Beetrooper
summary: Beetrooper cards only, paired with generic Insect Extra Deck monsters and staples. Beetroopers swarm the field through self-summoning Insects, climb into Link-2 and Link-4 bosses, and fuse into Beetrooper Cruel Saturnas and Ultra Beetrooper Absolute Hercules.

summary.title: Starters
points: Beetrooper Scout Buggy Special Summons a second copy of itself from the hand, Deck, or GY on Normal or Special Summon, immediately putting two Insects on the field for Beetrooper Armor Horn.

Beetrooper Sting Lancer Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase by placing an Insect from your GY and a monster from the opponent's GY on the bottom of the Decks, then searches any Beetrooper Spell/Trap on summon.

Beetrooper Scale Bomber Special Summons itself from the hand whenever an Insect is Normal or Special Summoned to your field, and Tributes an Insect as a Quick Effect to destroy an opposing monster that activates its effect on the field.

summary.title: Opening: Beetrooper Scout Buggy + Any Insect
steps: Normal Summon Beetrooper Scout Buggy to summon a second Scout Buggy from the Deck, then Link Summon Beetrooper Armor Horn.

Use Armor Horn's extra Insect Normal Summon or banish an Insect for Beetrooper Assault Roller, and Link Summon Giant Beetrooper Invincible Atlas or fuse via Beetrooper Landing into Beetrooper Cruel Saturnas.

Cruel Saturnas searches Beetrooper Formation or Beetrooper Fly & Sting, while Invincible Atlas Tributes an Insect (or Token) to summon Beetrooper Sting Lancer from the Deck for another Beetrooper Spell/Trap search.

summary.title: Beetrooper Cruel Saturnas & Insect Lock
summary.text: Beetrooper Cruel Saturnas can be Fusion Summoned via Beetrooper Landing and searches any Beetrooper card on Special Summon. Whenever an Insect is banished face-up while Saturnas is on the field (such as banishing 3 Insects from the GY to revive Beetrooper Armor Horn, or banishing for Heavy Beetrooper Mighty Neptune), Saturnas Special Summons one of your banished Beetrooper monsters. Because Scout Buggy, Armor Horn, Invincible Atlas, and Cruel Saturnas lock you into Insect Special Summons while on the field, the entire Extra Deck is pure Insect.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Giant Beetrooper Invincible Atlas cannot be targeted or destroyed by the opponent's card effects while at 3000 or less ATK, and Tributes an Insect to summon a Beetrooper from the Deck or gain 2000 ATK.

Ultra Beetrooper Absolute Hercules fuses 4 Insects for a 4000 ATK boss that is unaffected by other cards' effects until the end of your next turn and revives an Insect with 3000 or less ATK each End Phase.

Ultimate Great Insect can be Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by Tributing an Insect with 2000+ DEF equipped with an Equip Card (or fused via Landing) and destroys all monsters the opponent controls as a Quick Effect while a Field Spell is face-up.
Number 3: Cicada King negates a monster effect on the field, while Seraphim Papillion and Shinobi Insect Hagakuremino revive Insects from the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Beetrooper Formation revives a Beetrooper from the GY at the cost of LP equal to its original ATK and summons a Beetrooper Token whenever a face-up Insect you control is destroyed.
Beetrooper Landing Fusion Summons an Insect Fusion Monster and returns itself from the GY to the hand by banishing 2 Insects from the GY.
Beetrooper Fly & Sting negates an opposing monster effect while you control a Beetrooper and Sets itself back from the GY during the End Phase if you control a 3000+ ATK Insect.
